bull.narrative: Orla Mining achieves commercial production within the next 5 years, driven by successful project development and experienced management team, leading to significant revenue growth and market cap expansion.

base.narrative: Orla Mining makes steady progress in project development, achieves commercial production, but faces challenges and competition in the mining industry, resulting in moderate revenue growth and market cap expansion.

bear.narrative: Orla Mining fails to achieve commercial production within the next 5 years due to funding issues, project delays, or management team challenges, leading to significant revenue decline and market cap contraction.

tracking_note: Orla Mining's progress in project development and funding will be closely monitored to assess the likelihood of achieving commercial production.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to achieve commercial production within the next 5 years
